TLO real-format metadata undo test fixtures.
Generated from synthetic 440-Hz, 0.2-second sine-wave audio using an independent local FFmpeg encoder.
They are test fixtures only, never installed or shipped in executable application distributions.
Source-code CI uses these tiny checked-in media files to verify real Mutagen tag restoration without relying on a system ffmpeg executable.
Per-file original SHA-256 values are pinned in test_build711_remediation.py and the source ZIP checksum manifest.
